metadata.description: Till's marketplace for Claude Code plugins

plugins.name: spec
plugins.description: Spec workflow — document, explore, propose, grill, iterate, apply test-first (also in parallel), review, archive and retro changes, tweak small ones, link issues, and view them as HTML

plugins.name: md2pdf
plugins.description: Convert Markdown files to beautifully formatted PDFs with tables, code blocks, mermaid diagrams, images, and ASCII art

plugins.name: transform
plugins.description: Convert documents (DOCX, PDF, MSG) to clean Markdown

plugins.name: agent-bus
plugins.description: File-based inbox protocol for coordinating multiple Claude Code agents working on related repositories

plugins.name: md2html
plugins.description: Deterministic Markdown → HTML reports: directive registry, fmt, lint, PostToolUse hook, per-project CSS themes

plugins.name: autonomous
plugins.description: Work alone while the user is away: do whatever it takes to move on (commit, push, issues, archive, deploy) within three hard limits, log every decision in DECISIONS.md, finish test-first, self-review, retro, then keep testing end-to-end
